summary: Use the direct actual-state comparison to target the remaining quantitative and model-matching barriers. These are future questions, not additional investigations in this three-loop cycle.
ranking_basis: Prioritize what the changed-coupling certificate does not establish: return-to-cap accuracy, interaction sensitivity and a properly matched uniform model. Keep state uniqueness and continuum construction explicit.

goals.title: Return to the original coupling cap
goals.target: Obtain useful actual Euclidean precision at |tau|=10^-8 without silently lowering the coupling.
goals.missing_premise: The current square-root local state bound dominates the target. A sharper observable-specific estimate needs a complete remainder and actual-state justification.
goals.proposed_first_loop_test: Derive a state or observable comparison beyond the reset square-root bound, using the actual creation expansion only with its full normalization and support budget. Test the unchanged cap and original observable.
limitations: Failure of the present upper certificate is not proof of unavoidable actual error.

goals.title: Resolve an interaction-induced effect
goals.target: Find a certified quantity whose interacting enclosure excludes its matched free reference.
goals.missing_premise: The present certificate contains the free value; a rigorously bounded leading correction and smaller full remainder are needed.
goals.proposed_first_loop_test: Freeze a same-model observable, sign-sensitive correction and separation target before evaluating its coefficient and tail.
limitations: A nonzero Hamiltonian coefficient alone is not an observed correction.

goals.title: Match a uniform magnetic Hamiltonian
goals.target: Extend the comparison to explicitly matched selected and omitted plaquette coefficients.
goals.missing_premise: Nonzero selected terms change the reference ground state and all relevant error budgets. The exact coefficient dictionary and complete incidence must be proved.
goals.proposed_first_loop_test: Derive the full original-link coefficient map and a pure-electric reset budget charging every selected and omitted term, or prove a new non-Haar reference comparison.
limitations: The zero-selected patterned certificate does not imply uniform Wilson magnetic theory.
A strong-coupling uniform result would still not be a continuum construction.

goals.title: Identify limiting states and boundary effects
goals.target: Prove uniqueness or a quantitative boundary comparison for the relevant AQ thermodynamic state.
goals.missing_premise: Existing inequalities can hold for each chosen subsequential state without identifying those states or supplying a finite-volume convergence rate.
goals.proposed_first_loop_test: Freeze two boundary/construction families, a local observable class and a common physical clock; derive an explicit comparison in the required topology.
limitations: A common enclosing interval does not imply equality of states.

goals.title: Establish a continuum matching trajectory
goals.target: Connect a matched lattice family to a nontrivial four-dimensional continuum theory with the required axioms and positive physical gap.
goals.missing_premise: A regulator/coupling trajectory, physical scale control, continuum limits and full reconstruction hypotheses remain unproved.
goals.proposed_first_loop_test: State the regulator and coupling dictionary, then identify one necessary uniform estimate that the present fixed-lattice family actually supplies or fails to supply.
limitations: No fraction of the continuum proof is inferred from loop counts or small-coupling certificates.

methods_decision: Retain the installed historical-panel, Newton, Tesla and paired-research skills. Their existing provenance, complete-error and model-matching rules handled this round; no skill rewrite is needed. Future source snapshots must be frozen prospectively.
stop_boundary: This roadmap authorizes no new calculation. End research execution after AT6 review; integration, verification and publication add zero loops.
